candidates.description: This feature vector represents software usage, utility, and application development concepts in French and English.
This vector represents common French adverbial modifiers and conjunctive adverbs used to indicate time, frequency, manner, or logical connection.
This vector represents the concept of measuring, administering, or quantifying substances, particularly in a medical or chemical context.
These tokens represent indefinite determiners and adjectives denoting quantity, variety, or unspecified entities across French and English.
This feature vector activates strongly in the presence of chemical substances, pharmacological terms, and active pharmaceutical ingredients.
Elision markers attached to French words starting with a vowel or silent h.
This vector represents chemical compound suffixes and pharmacological drug classes, particularly focusing on nitrogen-containing organic molecules and psychoactive substances.
These tokens represent chemical, pharmaceutical, and scientific root prefixes and combining forms.
These tokens represent French third-person singular verb stems ending in "-re" or their common morphological suffixes.
These tokens represent units of measurement and quantities.
